description:
Pottery Barn or Home Goods Pt 33: Shelf styling. (Seriously walked away from this one battered and bruised 😂)

Highlights:
1. The triangle method: styling like-things together in threes so the eye naturally moves. Colors, textures, patterns. 
2. Use anchors on the top or bottom shelves. Larger pieces ground the space and instantly give the shelf purpose.
3. Layer decorative art in the back, behind the decor, to create depth and dimension. And remember! A tchotchke always has to have a partner! So put a little bowl on TOP of books.. not by itself 

✨comment SHELVES and I’ll send you all the things you need!
